newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Eletrobras down to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Eletrobras down to hold.

text.p: -- Credit Lyonnais said in a report it was downgrading Brazilian state-owned power utility Eletrobras to hold from buy.
-- Analyst Rosana Alworth said Eletrobras's share price had risen 85.7 percent so far this year, against a rise of 50.4 percent in the Sao Paulo bourse Ibovespa index.
-- She said Eletrobras had reached her 12-month target price of 490 reais.
-- Although the government is likely to begin privatizing Eletrobras's subsidiaries in 1998, in the near and medium term Aldworth expects Eletrobras share prices to underperform the Ibovespa.
-- Eletrobras preferred B shares were flat at 490 reais.
